cspaper.agent_framework: The primary reasoning approach utilized by the system, select from ['CoT', 'ToT', 'Multi-Agent Collaboration', 'Other'], leave blank if no agents are employed.
cspaper.evaluation_dataset: list all dataset names utilized for the experiment evaluations, including every dataset referenced in the document.
cspaper.use_agent: Indicate if the system clearly uses an agent-based design involving tasks like tool-calling or multi-step planning instead of just a straightforward processing step; select from ['Yes', 'No'].
cspaper.reasoning_depth: Choose either 'single-hop' or 'multi-hop' to represent the reasoning path length in the context of the method's application for the primary task or benchmark.
cspaper.baseline: The reference model or system utilized for comparative analysis throughout the study; enumerate all the baseline models identified in the document.
cspaper.performance_on_NQ: the outcome or quality of the approach as measured by the Natural Questions (NQ) evaluation. Include any noted scores or descriptive terms. Utilize concise language when no precise figures are available.
cspaper.performance_on_hotpotqa: the outcome or quality of the approach on the HotpotQA benchmark. Extract any listed measure(s) like F1, EM, accuracy, or other scores. If several measures are presented, use `||` to separate them. If only qualitative assessments (e.g., 'exceeds control group') are given, summarize them briefly.
